officialBio: Antiques, Vintage, Rustic, Collectibles, Gifts, Home Accents, Handcrafted, Accessories, Handbags, Jewelry, Furniture, and much more. Not a thrift store. We are a boutique of 50+ little shops that have a diverse array of finds. #MarketAtMacvicar
descriptionDraft: Explore a vintage boutique with more than 50 little shops offering antiques, collectibles, rustic decor, furniture, gifts, handcrafted goods, jewelry, handbags, and home accents. Find The Market at Macvicar at 2307 SW 10th Ave, Topeka, KS 66604, on the corner of 10th and Macvicar.
